flab.definition: n. loose or flaccid body fat

flabbed.definition:
past tense of flab
n. loose or flaccid body fat

flabber.translation: n. [口语]；松弛的肌肉；松弛(或不结实)的东西；松弛, 不结实

flabbergast.translation: vt. 使大吃一惊, 哑然失色

flabbergasted.definition:
v overcome with amazement
s as if struck dumb with astonishment and surprise
flabbergasted.translation: a. 目瞪口呆, 惊愕

flabbergasting.translation: v. 使吃惊, 使目瞪口呆( flabbergast的现在分词 )

flabbergasts.translation: v. 使吃惊, 使目瞪口呆( flabbergast的第三人称单数 )

flabbers.translation: (flabber 的第三人称 -s形式) n. [口语]；松弛的肌肉；松弛(或不结实)的东西；松弛, 不结实

flabbier.definition: s. out of condition; not strong or robust; incapable of exertion or endurance
flabbier.translation: a. 肌肉松垂的, 肥胖的( flabby的比较级 )

flabbies.definition:
plural of flabby
s out of condition; not strong or robust; incapable of exertion or endurance
flabbies.translation: (flabby 的复数) a. 软弱的, 没气力的, 不稳的, 松弛的

flabbiest.definition: s. out of condition; not strong or robust; incapable of exertion or endurance
flabbiest.translation: a. 肌肉松垂的, 肥胖的( flabby的最高级 )

flabbily.translation: adv. 软弱地, 无生气地, 无活力地, 松弛地

flabby.definition: s out of condition; not strong or robust; incapable of exertion or endurance
flabby.translation: a. 软弱的, 没气力的, 不稳的, 松弛的

flabellate.translation:
a. 扇形的
[医] 扇形的

flabellation.definition:
n. The act of keeping fractured limbs cool by the use of
   a fan or some other contrivance.

flabelliform.definition: a. Having the form of a fan; fan-shaped; flabellate.
flabelliform.translation: a. 扇状的, 扇形的

flabellinerved.definition:
a. Having many nerves diverging radiately from the
   base; -- said of a leaf.

flabellum.definition:
n. A fan; especially, the fan carried before the pope on
   state occasions, made in ostrich and peacock feathers.
flabellum.translation: n. [动]扇形器官(结构), 教皇仪仗扇

flabs.definition: n. loose or flaccid body fat
